subject: New lockbox for check payments - Acme Fasteners
text:
Dear Customer,

Acme Fasteners LLC has moved to a new bank-operated lockbox. Effective immediately, please mail all check payments to:

Acme Fasteners LLC
PO Box 790310
St. Louis, MO 63179-0310

Checks sent to our Cleveland office or the prior PO Box 2210 will be forwarded, which can add up to three weeks before they are credited.

ACH customers: separate instructions will be sent next week.

Thank you,
Acme Fasteners LLC
label: change_request
note: Borderline: a remit-to change for checks only. Labeled change_request because the lockbox is where checks (the money) land, and it also signals ACH instructions are about to change.
